definitions.explanation: Describes a person who is habitually lazy and makes no effort, or such behavior. As a noun it refers to such a person. Colloquial and mildly critical in tone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぐうたらだ。
examples.english: My little brother is really lazy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧ぐうたら⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: On my days off I laze around all day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ぐうたらだった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ようになった。
examples.english: He was a lazybones in his student days, but after getting a job he started working as if he were a different person.

notes:
Colloquial word for a habitually lazy person or lazy behavior. Used as a な-adjective (ぐうたらな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧) or as a noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ぐうたら⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧: a lazybones; good-for-nothing
- ぐうたらな⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: an idle, lazy lifestyle
- ぐうたら⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to laze around

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{怠|なま}け{者|もの}→怠け者：16970_namakemono⟧: lazy person — neutral-to-critical, more common in writing
- ⟦ものぐさ→ものぐさ：07867_monogusa⟧: someone who finds everything too much trouble — emphasizes not bothering rather than general idleness
